headline: U.S. Flash PMI Cools Across Manufacturing and Services
deck: Manufacturing and services readings also fell from October, while the composite remained above the line separating expansion from contraction.
body: Reuters reported that S&P Global’s preliminary November composite output index was 54.6, down from October’s 55.9. MarketReview described the reading as the slowest pace of expansion in four months across services and manufacturing. [E1] [E2] [E3] [E4]
TMG APAC reported that the manufacturing reading slipped to 54.5 from 54.9, while the services reading fell to 54.7 from 56.1. [E6] [E7]

MarketReview said 50 separates expansion from contraction, so its account characterised the lower composite reading as slower growth rather than a shrinking private sector. TMG APAC also reported affordability pressures and moderation in the rate of inflation in November. [E5] [E8]
